Eyebrow / supporting label

Lead paragraph. A direct introduction that explains the value of the section.

Body paragraph. Use clear, readable language and a comfortable measure. Keep one idea together and provide a useful next action.

Supporting text. Use for context, captions and helper messages.
Typeface: Switzer

Local font files are included. Use weights 400, 500 and 600 for hierarchy. Inputs, selects and textareas have a minimum font size of 1rem.

Headings use restrained negative tracking. Body text uses a line height around 1.7–1.85 for comfortable reading.

Parkezi design system

Rich text

Shared defaults for long-form content and product information.

A complete content example

Rich text should feel as considered as a landing page. These are the shared defaults for editorial pages, product information and case studies.

This paragraph contains strong emphasis, italic emphasis, an inline text link, superscript, subscript and highlighted text. A ANPR abbreviation can explain unfamiliar terms.

Useful information, clearly structured

  • Show a short, specific benefit.
  • Keep related information together.
    • Use a nested list only when the relationship needs it.
  • Give the reader a clear next action.

A short sequence

  1. Understand the site and access requirements.
  2. Choose the appropriate system and products.
  3. Discuss installation and ongoing support.
Use a blockquote for a verified quotation or a concise piece of editorial emphasis. Do not present demonstration text as a customer testimonial.
Technical information

Use inline code sparingly and give longer examples their own block.

Photography & products

Use real equipment and original installation imagery.

The homepage hero uses five individually positioned products. Do not replace them with a flattened family image. Outdoor SolarGate artwork uses the original site's separate background and product layers.

Parkezi design system

Interactions & feedback

Working state changes with clear, accessible behaviour.

Accordion · independently collapsible

How should content expand?

Keep the question visible, use a clear state indicator and allow the reader to close the answer.

What happens on mobile?

Content remains in document flow and uses readable text sizes. The homepage starts with five questions and reveals the remaining eight on demand.

Feedback states

Success message example. Describe what happened.

Error message example. Explain how to fix the issue.

Information message example. Keep it short and useful.

Motion

180ms for simple state feedback. 280ms for label rollovers and navigation. Longer movement is reserved for subtle imagery. Honour reduced-motion preferences. Keep hover effects available through keyboard focus where relevant.

Accessibility & content rules

Implementation principles for every future page.

Readable & usable

Inputs are 1rem minimum. Controls have generous hit areas. Body copy uses a comfortable line length and contrast.

Keyboard & assistive technology

Use semantic headings, visible labels and named buttons. Dialogs return focus. Tooltips work on focus and tap as well as hover.

Honest preview content

Unbuilt product pages display a scope notice with a link to the original website. Only source-verified Google reviews may populate the carousel. The profile link remains visible while review content is unavailable.

    Contact and interaction updates

    Phone CTAs use a fixed handset icon with rolling text. The contact and footer phone links have an outline border. Form fields use inline SVG icons and a minimum 1rem input size.

    Country picker

    Default: Australia +61. Search by country name, two-letter code or calling code. Arrow keys move through results, Enter selects and Escape closes. Flags are local SVG assets. The calling code is included with the form values.

    Photography and motion

    Mercure installation photos use Swiper with mouse drag, touch swipe, keyboard navigation, pagination and arrows. SolarGate has a fixed cabinet and a separately rotating barrier; touch users can open it with the button. Reduced-motion preferences are respected.

    Page rhythm

    SolarGate is followed by matching landscape installation photography and support content, then the dark software section. Marketing headings do not use eyebrow labels.
